shapeSummary: Black rectangular battery holder block, 58 mm long (X), 29 mm tall (Y), 48 mm wide (Z). Three parallel open-top AA cell troughs, 16 mm pitch, are cut along X from the top face. Walls and end walls are simple.
warnings: Dimensions come from unverified catalog data.
Y is treated as height (29 mm) to satisfy the bottom-at-Y=0 rule, which differs from the axis assumption in the image notes.
Only the top three cell cavities are modeled. The back-to-back lower cavities are not visible, so they are omitted.
Springs, flat contacts, rivets, end-wall slots and clips are omitted as contact hardware or detail.
Lead wires are omitted because they are outside the body bounds.
Cavity radius, depth and wall thickness are estimated from the image.

body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(58, 29, 48, centered=(True, False, True))
for z in (-16, 0, 16):
    cyl = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-26).center(22, z).circle(7.4).extrude(52)
